//: The reference to `packages/connect` is a BUILD-ORDER declaration, not a
resolves through the workspace symlink to that package's `dist` — and on a
clean clone `dist` does not exist yet. npm runs the two workspaces'
`prepare` scripts in its own order, so this package's `tsc` ran first and
died with TS2307, npm rolled the whole install back, and only a SECOND
`npm ci` succeeded, off the dist the rolled-back install had left behind.
Every clean clone and every CI runner hit it.
With the reference declared, `tsc -b` builds `packages/connect` before
this project whatever order npm picks, so the ordering is a property of
the compiler rather than of npm's script scheduling.
`tsBuildInfoFile` puts the build ledger INSIDE `dist` — here and in the
referenced project — so that `rm -rf dist` is a real clean. Left at its
default it sits beside this file, survives the delete, and `tsc -b` then
skips the emit and reproduces the very TS2307 above.
